# uor-repo-disposition Specification

<!-- Generated by Prism from prism/spec.json. Change the app through your agent with /prism, not by editing this file. -->

## Purpose

Repository disposition for the reorganization: Decide whether a UOR Foundation repository is kept, archived, folded into the repository that supersedes it, or put to the TOC for review, from the evidence read from the repositories at a pinned commit and the lifecycle of toc/README.md and GOVERNANCE.md 11.

## Requirements

### Requirement: Always archive when archived is yes

The app SHALL answer `archive` when archived is yes, because a repository GitHub holds archived is never reopened by the reorganization.

Verified: to be proved by Lean for every request (INV-001, theorem `inv001Holds`).

#### Scenario: INV-001 holds

- **WHEN** the request is `yes no none none none none quiet` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `archive`
- **AND** the app answers `archive`, decided by REQ-001

### Requirement: Never fold when statement is none

The app SHALL NOT answer `fold` when statement is none, because a fold needs a supersession statement naming its host; no other signal decides one.

Verified: to be proved by Lean for every request (INV-002, theorem `inv002Holds`).

#### Scenario: INV-002 holds

- **WHEN** the request is `yes no none none none none quiet` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL NOT be `fold`
- **AND** the app answers `archive`, decided by REQ-001

### Requirement: Never fold when statement is relocated

The app SHALL NOT answer `fold` when statement is relocated, because a statement that part of the content lives elsewhere is not supersession.

Verified: to be proved by Lean for every request (INV-003, theorem `inv003Holds`).

#### Scenario: INV-003 holds

- **WHEN** the request is `no no relocated member none names recent` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL NOT be `fold`
- **AND** the app answers `review`, decided by REQ-005

### Requirement: Always review when archived is no and reserved is no and statement is none and family is member

The app SHALL answer `review` when archived is no and reserved is no and statement is none and family is member, because name similarity alone raises a candidate and never decides one.

Verified: to be proved by Lean for every request (INV-004, theorem `inv004Holds`).

#### Scenario: INV-004 holds

- **WHEN** the request is `no no none member none none recent` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `review`
- **AND** the app answers `review`, decided by REQ-006

### Requirement: Never archive when archived is no and statement is none

The app SHALL NOT answer `archive` when archived is no and statement is none, because nothing but GitHub's own archival or a deprecation statement archives a repository.

Verified: to be proved by Lean for every request (INV-005, theorem `inv005Holds`).

#### Scenario: INV-005 holds

- **WHEN** the request is `no yes none none none none quiet` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL NOT be `archive`
- **AND** the app answers `keep`, decided by REQ-002

### Requirement: Always keep when archived is no and reserved is yes

The app SHALL answer `keep` when archived is no and reserved is yes, because the organization profile repository is always kept.

Verified: to be proved by Lean for every request (INV-006, theorem `inv006Holds`).

#### Scenario: INV-006 holds

- **WHEN** the request is `no yes none none none none quiet` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `keep`
- **AND** the app answers `keep`, decided by REQ-002

### Requirement: REQ-001 archive when archived is yes

The app SHALL answer `archive` when archived is yes, because GOVERNANCE.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) 11: Archived is the read-only historical state; toc/README.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Project Stages: Archived. A repo.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors (`rule1`).

#### Scenario: REQ-001 decides

- **WHEN** the request is `yes no none none none none quiet` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `archive`, decided by REQ-001

### Requirement: REQ-002 keep when reserved is yes

The app SHALL answer `keep` when reserved is yes and no earlier rule matches, because GitHub Docs, Customizing your organization's profile and Creating a default community health file: the organization profile and default health files are read only from the public .github repository, so it is never archived or folded.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors (`rule2`).

#### Scenario: REQ-002 decides

- **WHEN** the request is `no yes none none none none quiet` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `keep`, decided by REQ-002

### Requirement: REQ-003 fold when statement is superseded

The app SHALL answer `fold` when statement is superseded and no earlier rule matches, because toc/README.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Project Stages: Archived on supersession, by TOC vote (simple majority); GOVERNANCE.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) 11: arc.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors (`rule3`).

#### Scenario: REQ-003 decides

- **WHEN** the request is `no no superseded none none none recent` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `fold`, decided by REQ-003

### Requirement: REQ-004 archive when statement is deprecated

The app SHALL answer `archive` when statement is deprecated and no earlier rule matches, because toc/README.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Project Stages: Archived for a project no longer recommended or on maintainer request, by TOC vote (simple majority); GOVERNANCE.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors (`rule4`).

#### Scenario: REQ-004 decides

- **WHEN** the request is `no no deprecated none shared none recent` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `archive`, decided by REQ-004

### Requirement: REQ-005 review when statement is relocated

The app SHALL answer `review` when statement is relocated and no earlier rule matches, because toc/README.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Project Stages: supersession is a TOC decision; a statement that part of the content lives in another repository is evidence for it, not the decision.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors (`rule5`).

#### Scenario: REQ-005 decides

- **WHEN** the request is `no no relocated member none names recent` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `review`, decided by REQ-005

### Requirement: REQ-006 review when family is member

The app SHALL answer `review` when family is member and no earlier rule matches, because STANDARDS.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Naming Conventions and GOVERNANCE.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) 11: a shared name is a naming convention, not supersession.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors (`rule6`).

#### Scenario: REQ-006 decides

- **WHEN** the request is `no no none member none none recent` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `review`, decided by REQ-006

### Requirement: REQ-007 review when consumer is sole

The app SHALL answer `review` when consumer is sole and no earlier rule matches, because toc/README.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Project Stages: Archived needs inactivity, a maintainer request or supersession; a single Foundation consumer is none of these and raises a candidate for the TO.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors (`rule7`).

#### Scenario: REQ-007 decides

- **WHEN** the request is `no no none none sole none recent` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `review`, decided by REQ-007

### Requirement: REQ-008 review when overlap is names

The app SHALL answer `review` when overlap is names and no earlier rule matches, because toc/README.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Project Stages: supersession is a TOC decision; a purpose statement naming a repository it does not depend on raises a candidate for the TOC.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors (`rule8`).

#### Scenario: REQ-008 decides

- **WHEN** the request is `no no none none none names recent` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `review`, decided by REQ-008

### Requirement: REQ-009 review when activity is quiet

The app SHALL answer `review` when activity is quiet and no earlier rule matches, because toc/README.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) Project Stages: Archived on sustained inactivity, which no Foundation norm quantifies; a quiet window raises a candidate for the TOC.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors (`rule9`).

#### Scenario: REQ-009 decides

- **WHEN** the request is `no no none none none none quiet` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `review`, decided by REQ-009

### Requirement: Otherwise keep

The app SHALL answer `keep` when no rule matches, because GOVERNANCE.md (UOR-Foundation/.github@92da114114fc9b76cbf2c5168e29d409b62ddde8) 11: a repository with no archival, supersession or candidate signal stays Active or in Maintenance.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors.

#### Scenario: No rule matches

- **WHEN** the request is `no no none hub shared none recent` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `keep`

### Requirement: The first matching rule decides

The app SHALL try REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-003, REQ-004, REQ-005, REQ-006, REQ-007, REQ-008, REQ-009 in that order, and the first rule that matches SHALL decide.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors.

#### Scenario: Two rules match

- **WHEN** the request is `yes no none none none none quiet` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `archive`, decided by REQ-001, the earlier rule

### Requirement: Request and answers

The app SHALL read one request as one line of 7 fields separated by single spaces, in this order, and SHALL answer exactly one of `keep`, `archive`, `fold`, `review`, or `invalid` for anything else.

| Field | Accepts | Means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `archived` | `yes`, `no` | whether GitHub holds the repository archived |
| `reserved` | `yes`, `no` | whether the repository name is one GitHub reserves for the organization, the .github profile and community-health repository |
| `statement` | `superseded`, `deprecated`, `relocated`, `none` | the strongest statement its README makes about itself: superseded by or moved to a named Foundation repository, deprecated or no longer maintained, part of its content belonging in a named Foundation repository, or none |
| `family` | `none`, `hub`, `member` | whether its name shares a word, other than the identity word uor, with another Foundation repository, and if so whether it is the one of that family the most Foundation repositories depend on |
| `consumer` | `none`, `sole`, `shared` | how many other Foundation repositories depend on it by a package, workflow or submodule: none, exactly one, or more |
| `overlap` | `none`, `names` | whether its purpose statement names, as GitHub spells it, another Foundation repository outside its dependency closure |
| `activity` | `recent`, `quiet` | whether its default branch has a commit in the evidence window before the snapshot |

| Answer | Means |
| --- | --- |
| `keep` | kept as an active or maintenance repository (GOVERNANCE.md 11) |
| `archive` | archived: the TOC Archived stage, read-only with its context kept in the README |
| `fold` | folded: its content imported into the kept repository that supersedes it, then archived by TOC vote |
| `review` | a candidate the evidence raises but does not decide: the TOC must decide it |
| `invalid` | the request is malformed |

Verified: reading a request is tested, not proved.

#### Scenario: A malformed request is invalid

- **WHEN** the request is not 7 fields in this order
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `invalid`

## Examples

- `yes no none none none none quiet` gives `archive`
- `yes no superseded member sole names recent` gives `archive`
- `no yes none none none none quiet` gives `keep`
- `no no superseded none none none recent` gives `fold`
- `no no deprecated none shared none recent` gives `archive`
- `no no relocated member none names recent` gives `review`
- `no no none member none none recent` gives `review`
- `no no none hub shared none recent` gives `keep`
- `no no none none sole none recent` gives `review`
- `no no none none none names recent` gives `review`
- `no no none none none none quiet` gives `review`
- `no no none none shared none recent` gives `keep`
- `no no none none none none recent` gives `keep`

## What is proved and what is tested

Lean proves each property marked proved above, for every request that decodes, with no exceptions and no sampling. The proof is about `judge`, the function the WebAssembly guest runs, because both come from the same model.

The parsing of requests is tested, not proved: the acceptance vectors in the app replay through the built guest, including malformed and oversized requests.

Nothing here says the rules are the right rules. That is the part only you can judge.
